sprites.name: bar_roof_snow
sprites.notes: Snow on the bar's flat roof, cut to its narrower 90 units.

sprites.name: bird_body
sprites.notes: Redrawn in v76.3. The V2 gull was a flat angular M whose wing tips pointed down, which reads as a bat at the size it is drawn; it is now a swept pair of wings with a body, a head and a beak. Symmetric about its own horizontal centre on purpose: PaperRenderer.drawBirds animates the flap by mirroring the sprite vertically, so anything above the centre line would end up below it for half the cycle. The head points right because birds only ever drift right.

sprites.name: bunny_body
sprites.notes: Placed as a part, not on its own content bottom. The ears reach further left than right, so the body's content centre is not the animal's visual centre, and the call site deliberately offsets it by three units to put the ears over the head. Declaring CONTENT_BOTTOM_CENTRE said otherwise.

sprites.name: dolphin_body
sprites.notes: Redrawn in v76.4. The V2 fish read as a shark: pointed snout, tall triangular dorsal, no visible eye or mouth. It is now a porpoise -- rounded melon, curved dorsal, pale belly, pectoral fin, eye and smile line -- and it faces right, which is the only direction lake decorations drift. PaperRenderer.drawLakeDecorations draws it only while it is above the water, so the animal breaches and dives instead of gliding across the surface.

sprites.name: firetruck_body
sprites.notes: New in v76.1. The fire truck shared car_body, so it had a taxi's silhouette under a red tint and read as a car with a ladder above it. This is its own body: flat roof at local y=-16 against the sedan's -11, a cab with its own window, a cream stripe over three equipment lockers, and a dark chassis the wheels sit into. Drawn by SceneObjectRenderer.drawFireTruck at (-50,-26), after firetruck_ladder so the roof line paints over its lower rail.

sprites.name: house_large_roof_snow
sprites.notes: Snow on house_large_roof. Same construction as house_small_roof_snow, cut to the larger roof's slopes.

sprites.name: house_small_roof_snow
sprites.notes: Snow lying on house_small_roof, cut to that roof's own slopes and cresting four units above its ridge. Sized and anchored from the roof, so the two must be re-derived together.

sprites.name: house_window
sprites.notes: Present in the asset library but reached from no call site, so it has no scale or anchor the code can be checked against. Whether the orphans should ship at all is ROADMAP.md 5.5 and 7.2, not an asset question.

sprites.name: moon_crescent
sprites.notes: Terminator arc corrected in v76.1. The shipped path closed the lit limb with `A52 34 0 0 0`, an ellipse whose 52-unit x-radius bulged 12 units past the disc and 12 past the canvas, so the crescent was clipped flat by its own 240px edge -- the vertical cut reported from the device. The arc is now `A20 34 0 0 0`, which stays inside the disc.

sprites.name: moon_gibbous
sprites.notes: Terminator arc corrected in v76.1, same defect family as moon_crescent. The shipped path used `A20 34 0 1 0`: a large-arc flag on an under-sized radius, which drew a thin crescent rather than a gibbous and left the crater circle outside the lit shape as a floating dot. Now `A18 34 0 0 1`, bulging away from the lit limb so more than half the disc is lit.

sprites.name: moon_jack_o_lantern
sprites.notes: Halloween moon. Carved rather than painted: the face is cut out of the disc with an even-odd path, so the sky shows through the eyes, the nose and the grin -- the same paper-cutout move the rest of the library makes, and the reason it still reads at 48 px across. Shares CELESTIAL_DISC_ORIGIN_UNITS with the sun and the phases, so its canvas has to match theirs exactly.

sprites.name: palmtree_fronds_dead
sprites.notes: Halloween palm crown: the same fan, dead. Drawn on palmtree_fronds' canvas with the same content box, so it blits at the same origin and the Christmas lights and the frost overlay keep the geometry they were derived from. Fixed art in the trunk browns -- a dead frond is not a theme colour.

sprites.name: penguin_body
sprites.notes: Placed as a part, not on its own content bottom: the penguin stands on penguin_feet, which is blitted separately at the ground line, so the body correctly sits one unit above it. Declaring CONTENT_BOTTOM_CENTRE said the body itself met the ground and made a correct composition look like defect D-9.

sprites.name: restaurant_roof_snow
sprites.notes: Snow standing proud of the restaurant's flat parapet. The wall's top edge is four units down this canvas; the units above it are what make it a layer rather than a painted stripe.

sprites.name: road_asphalt
sprites.notes: Present in the asset library but reached from no call site, so it has no scale or anchor the code can be checked against. Whether the orphans should ship at all is ROADMAP.md 5.5 and 7.2, not an asset question.

sprites.name: road_curb
sprites.notes: Present in the asset library but reached from no call site, so it has no scale or anchor the code can be checked against. Whether the orphans should ship at all is ROADMAP.md 5.5 and 7.2, not an asset question.

sprites.name: road_line
sprites.notes: Present in the asset library but reached from no call site, so it has no scale or anchor the code can be checked against. Whether the orphans should ship at all is ROADMAP.md 5.5 and 7.2, not an asset question.

sprites.name: santa_sleigh_scene
sprites.notes: Redrawn in v76.3: a cozier Santa -- rounder coat, fuller beard with a rounded hem, rosy cheeks, a smile, a slouched hat with a larger pompom, a mitten on the reins -- and the first of two leg poses. Frame two is santa_sleigh_trot. Both are emitted from one description so they cannot drift apart; only the reindeer legs differ, and the two reindeer are in opposite phases within a frame.

sprites.name: santa_sleigh_trot
sprites.notes: New in v76.3: the second leg pose of santa_sleigh_scene. The reindeer stopped moving their legs when the group became a single sprite in v73, because a bitmap cannot bend; the trot is a second drawing alternated by PaperRenderer at SANTA_TROT_FRAMES_PER_SECOND. Identical to frame one except for the four legs of each reindeer.

sprites.name: skyscraper_roof_snow
sprites.notes: Snow on the tower's setback roof, the only horizontal surface of it a viewer sees. Deliberately shallower than the houses': a roof this high is swept.

sprites.name: star_sparkle
sprites.notes: The V2 manifest declared this sprite CANVAS_PIXELS. That is defect D-1 restated: read as raw pixels the 180px sparkle would cover 180 local units against a star's own 32, which is the three-times-too-large rendering v73.7 fixed. The scale here follows PaperRenderer.drawStars, which is the source of truth for a convention; the tint class follows the manifest, and the call site was moved to an untinted blit to match it.

sprites.name: tree_canopy_snowcap
sprites.notes: Redrawn in v76.1 so the cap follows tree_canopy's own crown outline: its top edge repeats the crown's upper vertices, so the snow reaches both shoulders and the ridge. The shipped 216x126 cap sat inside them, leaving a green rim above the snow and bare corners either side. Sized and anchored from the canopy, so the two must be re-derived together.

sprites.name: tree_dead_branches
sprites.notes: Halloween crown: bare forked limbs on the canopy canvas, so it blits at the canopy origin and meets the trunk where the canopy did. Fixed art in the trunk browns rather than tintable -- a dead tree is not a theme colour, and tinting it with a leaf colour is the one thing that would give the effect away.

sprites.name: water_splash0
sprites.notes: Dolphin re-entry, first frame: the crown thrown up at the instant the body meets the surface. Shares a canvas with water_splash1 so one origin serves both frames.

sprites.name: water_splash1
sprites.notes: Dolphin re-entry, second frame: the crown collapsed to a low mound with the droplets thrown wider and higher. Same canvas as water_splash0.
